landing.title: Stop answering the same employee question twice.
landing.subtitle: OrgChai turns your approved handbook, onboarding, and IT guides into source-backed answers in Slack and on the web. Give employees self-service without starting an enterprise search project.
landing.ctaNote: Best fit: 50 to 150 employees, 20 to 80 approved documents, and one clear content owner.
landing.proof1: Built for a two-week first rollout
landing.featuresTitle: Your documents are not the problem. The handoff is.
landing.featuresDescription: When employees ask the same policy and onboarding questions every week, People Ops becomes the search engine. OrgChai gives them a clear, verifiable answer path.
landing.feature1Description: Search approved company documents before answering, then show the source so employees can verify the policy instead of trusting a black box.
landing.feature2Description: Give employees a focused web workspace and Slack access. Both use the same controlled knowledge base for consistent answers.
landing.feature3Description: Start with a small, approved source set and one accountable content owner. Add a useful answer layer without taking on an enterprise search rollout.
landing.problemTitle: The same question keeps finding the same person.
landing.problemDescription: The pattern is familiar: a message arrives, someone searches a policy, and a People Ops or IT lead writes the answer again.
landing.problem1Title: Every policy question becomes a handoff.
landing.problem1Description: Leave, benefits, expenses, and remote work questions interrupt the people responsible for higher-value work.
landing.problem2Title: New hires search before they start.
landing.problem2Description: The answer exists, but it is split across handbooks, checklists, folders, and old links.
landing.problem3Description: Access, setup, and security questions land wherever someone happens to be available.
landing.workflowTitle: Prove the value with the questions you already see.
landing.workflowDescription: Start narrow, use trusted documents, and measure the operational problem you want to reduce. The first rollout should be useful before it becomes broad.
landing.step1Description: Bring 20 to 80 approved documents, such as the handbook, benefits guide, onboarding checklist, security guide, and key runbooks.
landing.step2Description: Employees ask natural-language questions in the web workspace or Slack instead of searching filenames or interrupting a teammate.
landing.step3Description: Track repeated questions, source coverage, and gaps in the documentation. Keep the content owner in control of what gets indexed.
landing.useCasesDescription: Choose a workflow to see how a repeated question becomes a source-backed answer.
landing.motionHint: Watch the workflows rotate, or choose one to explore.
landing.useCase1Title: Answer handbook questions without the handoff
landing.useCase1Description: Give employees clear guidance on leave, benefits, expenses, remote work, and workplace policies before another message reaches People Ops.
landing.useCase1Question: What is our parental leave policy?
landing.useCase2Title: Give new hires a reliable first week
landing.useCase2Description: Turn onboarding checklists, team norms, and account setup instructions into answers new hires can use without waiting for a manager.
landing.useCase2Question: What should I complete before my first day?
landing.useCase3Description: Surface approved setup, security, and troubleshooting steps before another routine question reaches a lean IT or operations team.
landing.useCase3Question: How do I report a suspicious email?
landing.fitTitle: A focused first rollout beats a broad AI project.
landing.fitDescription: OrgChai is built for a clear operational trigger, not for every knowledge problem at once.
landing.fitGoodDescription: You have 50 to 150 employees, active Slack usage, repeated handbook or onboarding questions, and one person who can own the approved source documents.
landing.fitNotYetDescription: A full enterprise search layer, many native connectors, granular document permissions, or autonomous actions across business systems.
landing.securityTitle: Keep the answer layer inside clear boundaries.
landing.securityDescription: The first version should make trusted information easier to use, not pretend to replace your systems of record.
landing.securityNote: Client requests pass through the web server. The application API key is never shipped in the browser bundle.
landing.security1Description: Firebase ID tokens are verified before protected API routes return user-specific data.
landing.security2Description: PostgreSQL stores chat history by user while the pilot source collection is managed as a shared organizational set.
landing.security3Description: Configured administrators control which documents are added to or removed from the shared knowledge base.
landing.finalEyebrow: Ready when the questions are real
landing.finalTitle: Bring the last 20 repeated questions into one pilot.
landing.finalDescription: Start with the documents you trust, give employees a clear place to ask, and see whether the repeat work actually goes down.
landing.footerDescription: Source-backed employee self-service for lean teams.

preview.question: Can I carry unused leave into next year?
preview.answer: Unused annual leave can be carried forward up to five days. Submit the request in the HR portal before December 15. The policy owner is People Ops.
